name: clipforge
description: ClipForge - Distributed Lecture Video Processing Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../workers && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "CLIENT,SERVER1,SERVER2,WORKERS" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow" "npm run dev:client" "cd server && cross-env PORT=4001 npm run dev" "cd server && cross-env PORT=4002 npm run dev" "npm run dev:workers"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:workers
